title: Plans with monthly limits, Premium, invite reward 3 videos
notes: Plus is 50 videos a month, Pro 120, and a new Premium plan has 250 (299.000đ / ¥109 / Rp259.000)
Interactive video is counted per month: free 2, Plus 10, Pro 30, Premium 80; the switch, the make form and the home page show how many are left
Interactive mode is chosen per video, so watching a shared or old video never uses one by surprise
In-depth answers per video: free 3, Plus 10, Pro 20, Premium 30
Inviting a friend now gives 3 videos; an approved student or teacher gets the Plus month with its 50 videos

title: New admin console, usernames, account switcher, personal home
notes: Admin is now eight tabs, grouped by what you decide: Overview, Revenue, Members, Audience, Videos and usage, Infrastructure, Releases, Feedback
Big charts with a period filter (today, 7, 30, 90, 180 days or your own dates), daily, weekly or monthly grouping and a hover read-out; every table has filters, search and paging
Infrastructure: space left in video storage, database, file storage and video traffic, the model gateway (RKAPI) balance, stuck jobs and the last backup, with warning colours
Audience: visitors, members chosen country, country from the connection, language, where they heard about us and who they are, as bar charts
Releases: suite versions with bullet points and times, plus every merged change per app with its own bullets

Sign in with your email or a username; sign-up asks for a username; Settings changes it; accounts saved on a device can be switched in the profile menu, and another account can be added without logging out

A member's home is now their own page: username, plan with due date and days left, videos you can make now (free plus credits), their videos with state, progress, invite and the student month. The introduction sections are for visitors only
A student or teacher whose proof is approved sees a notice on the home page and gets an email when mail is set up
Explanation for each quiz question is prepared with the question; shared links are watch-only; one name for the stronger answers: In-depth mode

title: Proof and payment viewer, early stop on unreadable files, mobile polish
notes: Admin: View proof opens the student or teacher file as a picture, with Approve and Reject inside. Fixed: approving failed because the proof id was checked as a UUID
Fixed: the browser saved proof photos as broken files; they are real JPEGs now, and the broken ones already sent can still be viewed
Payment step: optional screenshot of the payment, shown to the admin when confirming the order
A garbled, scanned or protected file or link now stops at the first step with a clear message, before any script or video is made
Plus is 100 videos. Vietnam prices: Plus 89.000 VND and Pro 159.000 VND a month
One name for the stronger answers everywhere: In-depth mode (Chuyen sau). Pricing lines say plainly what is included
Interactive video: the explanation for each question is written together with the question, so Explain this more is instant
A shared video link is for watching: asking, quizzes and answers need a free account, unless the browser made the video
Phones: the quiz opens as a bottom sheet, lighter progress and parts list, round help button, bigger tap targets. Studio text follows the page language
Footer: copyright line in four languages

title: Email confirmation and reset, everything in four languages, study pack
notes: Sign-up confirmation by email and Forgot password by email, built for both Chinese and global mailboxes (Aliyun DirectMail and Resend). Switches on when the mail keys are added; until then sign-up works as before
Reading Companion now speaks Vietnamese and Indonesian, and the agent answers in the chosen language
One language for every Paperlit app: pick it once and it follows you. Dashboard, pricing, payment and feedback texts are now in Vietnamese and Indonesian
Study pack for Plus and Pro: notes of every part and flashcards (Anki CSV) from a video
Admin: orders show the amount in the member's own money and have Mark paid and Cancel buttons
The static Check the result pages use the Paperlit brand and the same three product names
Fixes: a sign-in race that could sign a member out right after confirming, 1 free video wording, the how-to button no longer covers the page on phones

title: Interactive quiz: ready before you play, history, final score
notes: All questions of a video are written in one go as soon as interactive mode is on, and saved, so each question appears instantly
Explain this more now shows the explanation inside the video, not in another tab
New Quiz tab: every answer you gave with a score, review of each question, reset to answer again
Final quiz: generate a test on the whole video after watching, get a score and keep the history to review
Admin: suite version history with notes for every release, per-app change list, income and cost, audience, chart filters and paging
Plus is 99 videos and Pro is 200 videos, with a Custom box that opens Contact us

title: Any source, local prices, money and audience in admin
notes: Make form: choose Link, Paste text or Upload file. Any web page, pasted text and .txt or .md files work, not only papers
Language now sits with length, tone and voice, and the settings are open from the start. The EN + Chinese option is gone
Prices in dong for Vietnam and rupiah for Indonesia, no exchange rate. Plus 99 videos, Pro 200 videos, Custom plan with Contact us
Sign-up asks for country and language (required), where you heard about us and your role (optional)
Admin: income, cost and profit with trends, who the members are by country, version history, chart filters and paging
Navbar shortened and the menu is now called Apps. Plain footer without the team and partner lines. Credit history and password always visible

title: Quiz inside the video, share link, new Plus and Pro, proof for students and teachers
notes: Interactive questions now appear inside the video, so they also work in full screen. Interactive mode can be chosen when making a video or later
Share this video: one link that opens the video and its questions
Plus and Pro redesigned. Pro (59 yuan) gets 10 minute videos, unlimited careful answers and a year of storage. Pro card has its own colour and the buttons line up
Students and teachers get one free month of Plus after sending a proof, reviewed in the admin page
Invite a friend and get 10 free videos when they sign up
A video you close the page on keeps rendering and comes back when you return. Member page and dashboard open at once from the last visit
Wording: Fast and Deep became Quick and Thorough, background became general knowledge, Tour became How to use
